title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 21:00 UTC on 24 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 24 日 21:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.00 (0Z) at 21:00 UTC on 24 September. The 21:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 21:59; hour-start 0.00/0Z, hour-end 2.00/2Z). Last-180 maximum is 2.67 (first at 2026-09-24 19:49 UTC; label 3M; last-180 window from 19:15 UTC). Published-window maximum is 3.00 (first at 2026-09-24 16:43 UTC; label 3Z). Window start 2026-09-24 16:18 UTC (357 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 22:00 UTC hour is still incomplete (15 samples through 22:14) and is not used as the main card.
summary.zh: 最後可靠整點估計 Kp 為 0.00（0Z），取樣 2026-09-24 21:00 UTC。21:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 21:59，時段初 0.00／0Z、時段末 2.00／2Z）。近 180 筆最大 2.67（最先見於 2026-09-24 19:49 UTC；標籤 3M；近 180 筆窗自 19:15 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 3.00（最先見於 2026-09-24 16:43 UTC；標籤 3Z）。窗起點 2026-09-24 16:18 UTC（357 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。22:00 UTC 時段尚未收滿（至 22:14 僅 15 筆），不作為主卡片。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (21:00 UTC on 24 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 21:00 UTC is 0.00/0Z; the hour ends 2.00/2Z at 21:59. The 22:00 UTC hour on 24 September is incomplete.

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.6, depth about 48.469 km. Current day-feed maximum is mww 5.3 (us6000tx9u, 15 km SSW of Hilvan, Turkey).
